regression_intro_subject: perf: accumulate whole tokens to avoid float drift; add available()
guarantee_subject: feat: TokenBucket with continuous refill (partial tokens carry over)
bug_report: Users on a low fractional rate report the limiter NEVER lets requests through after the bucket empties. Example: a TokenBucket(rate=0.5, capacity=1) stays empty forever even though half a token should accrue each second. A failing repro test is included at tests/test_regression.py. Fix the bug so partial tokens accrue again, without breaking existing behaviour.
